subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Pre-K English Language Arts: Early Literacy & Phonemic Awareness
overview: Pre-K English Language Arts immerses young learners in rich literature, structured phonics routines, vocabulary enrichment, and expressive writing workshops.
competencies: Demonstrate phonemic awareness and mastery of grade-appropriate decoding patterns.
Retell stories with key details, identifying central characters, settings, and sequence of events.
Extract and communicate central ideas from informational texts.
Compose well-structured sentences and narrative/opinion compositions using standard conventions.

modules.title: Print Concepts & Book Appreciation
modules.description: Fosters book handling skills, recognizing letters, and distinguishing between words and pictures.

topics.title: Book Handling & Left-to-Right Tracking
topics.description: Holding books right-side up, turning pages, and tracking text directionality.

topics.title: Environmental Print & Letter Recognition
topics.description: Recognizing letters in their own names and high-frequency classroom labels.

modules.title: Phonological Awareness & Rhyme
modules.description: Developing auditory sensitivity to rhyme, rhythm, and spoken syllables through playful songs and poetry.

topics.title: Rhyming Games & Nursery Rhymes
topics.description: Identifying rhyming word pairs and completing predictable rhyming phrases.

topics.title: Clapping Syllables & Sound Isolation
topics.description: Segmenting spoken words into syllables and identifying common beginning sounds.

modules.title: Oral Expression & Emergent Storytelling
modules.description: Encouraging expressive speech, retelling familiar stories using illustrations, and emergent drawing.

topics.title: Listening Comprehension & Story Retelling
topics.description: Asking and answering questions about characters and events in read-alouds.

topics.title: Drawing & Dictating Thoughts
topics.description: Expressing ideas, preferences, and personal narratives through drawing and scribing.
